instruction: A candid outdoor full shot of a sunny park with lush green grass and leafy trees. On the left, the woman with dark hair tied back (R4) in a dark blue t-shirt and light blue jeans leans forward with clapped hands, looking to the right with an excited expression. On the right, the bald man (R2) in a dark blue t-shirt and black pants stands with his hands clasped together at his chest, smiling back at her. They stand near each other, reacting to a game under bright natural sunlight.
